    segments = case['segments']
    names = [seg['name'] for seg in segments]

    capacities = [seg['capacity'] for seg in segments]
    budget = case['budget']
    n = len(segments)
    sum_min = sum(minima)
    sum_cap = sum(capacities)

        raise ValueError('Budget out of range')
    allocations = list(minima)
    remaining = budget - sum_min
    while remaining > 0:
        best_idx = -1
        best_ratio = -1.0
        for i in range(n):
            if allocations[i] >= capacities[i]:
                continue
            ratio = importances[i] / (allocations[i] + 1)
            if ratio > best_ratio or (ratio == best_ratio and i < best_idx):
                best_ratio = ratio
                best_idx = i
        if best_idx == -1:
            raise ValueError('Unexpected - no capacity')
        allocations[best_idx] += 1
        remaining -= 1
    total = sum(allocations)
    by_name = {names[i]: allocations[i] for i in range(n)}
    return {
        'allocations': allocations,
        'by_name': by_name,
        'total': total
    }"}
